title: Google Cloud says its SpaceX compute deal is a "short-term" agreement "to ensure we have bridge capacity to meet surging customer demand" for Gemini Enterprise (Kate Conger/New York Times)
summary: Kate Conger / New York Times: Google Cloud says its SpaceX compute deal is a “short-term” agreement “to ensure we have bridge capacity to meet surging customer demand” for Gemini Enterprise — Elon Musk's rocket company said Google would pay it $920 million a month, as it prepared for its initial public offering.
contentText:
Kate Conger / New York Times :

Google Cloud says its SpaceX compute deal is a “short-term” agreement “to ensure we have bridge capacity to meet surging customer demand” for Gemini Enterprise   —  Elon Musk's rocket company said Google would pay it $920 million a month, as it prepared for its initial public offering.
